svg.title: Smart-Glasses and Smartwatch MicroLLMs Meets LastExam Epistemic Calibration: 5,984 B Watch SRAM Nucleus, Zero-Poison Opener Gate, and Multi-Scale Calibration
svg.desc: Four-panel synthesis of Claims LA-36 through LA-38: (A) 64 KB smartwatch SRAM feasibility (5,984 B = 9.13% vs 14 MB uLM-28M INT4 overflow) and 56-bit 4-token uLM-28M opener + epistemic hold hardware telemetry across Jetson AGX Thor DC shunt measured_j, AMD Zen 5 RAPL, Apple M5 Max, and live OpenMV-AE3 Cortex-M55 DWT cycles; (B) 64-query Smart-Glasses and Smartwatch bimodal stream accuracy and collaborative prefix poisoning suppression (0.0% poisoned prefixes on MoL vs UW/Meta uLM-28M prefix masking); (C) LastExam-protocol closed-ended accuracy vs RMS Calibration Error and Confident Hallucination Rate across 28M to 35B models; and (D) 58 six-kernel Lean 4.36.0 theorems (1,422 fleet) and hle:3r2s canary quarantine.
